about: Choice of 2 Elite Players (1 Offensive & 1 Defensive)
Introducing the FieldSENSE™ Gameplay System in Madden NFL 23

Providing the foundation for consistent, ultra-realistic gameplay, and available on PlayStation®5, FieldSENSE equips players with more control at all positions in every mode. FieldSENSE leverages animation branching technology and a suite of new user control mechanics for a seamless gameplay flow with authentic results on every play.
More ball-carrier fluidity to hit gaps & elude defenders so you can break more big plays.
All-new way to pass introduces a new accuracy reticle & pass meter.
Next-gen Hit-Stick physics enable mid-air knockouts, hit the pile to assist tackles in progress & force turnovers with stand up tackles.
